label: Philippians 1:1
text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of mine, to all the saints in me which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

label: Philippians 1:2
text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from my Father, and from me.

label: Philippians 1:3
text: Paul thanked my Father upon every remembrance of you,

label: Philippians 1:4
text: Always in every prayer of his for you all making request with joy,

label: Philippians 1:5
text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

label: Philippians 1:6
text: Being confident of this very thing, that I which have begun a good work in you will perform it until my day:

label: Philippians 1:7
text: Even as it is meet for him to think this of you all, because he hath you in his heart; inasmuch as both in his bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of his grace.

label: Philippians 1:8
text: For my Father is his record, how greatly he longed after you all in the bowels of mine.

label: Philippians 1:9
text: And this he prayed, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

label: Philippians 1:10
text: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till my day;

label: Philippians 1:11
text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by me, unto the glory and praise of my Father.

label: Philippians 1:12
text: But he would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto him have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

label: Philippians 1:13
text: So that his bonds in me are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

label: Philippians 1:14
text: And many of the brethren in me, waxing confident by his bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

label: Philippians 1:15
text: Some indeed preach me even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

label: Philippians 1:16
text: The one preach me of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to his bonds:

label: Philippians 1:17
text: But the other of love, knowing that he was set for the defence of the gospel.

label: Philippians 1:18
text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, I am preached; and he therein doth rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

label: Philippians 1:19
text: For he knew that this shall turn to his salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of mine,

label: Philippians 1:20
text: According to his earnest expectation and his hope, that in nothing he shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also I shall be magnified in his body, whether it be by life, or by death.

label: Philippians 1:21
text: For to him to live was for me, and to die was gain.

label: Philippians 1:22
text: But if he lived in the flesh, this was the fruit of his labour: yet what he should choose he wot not.

label: Philippians 1:23
text: For he was in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with me; which is far better:

label: Philippians 1:24
text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

label: Philippians 1:25
text: And having this confidence, he knew that he should abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

label: Philippians 1:26
text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in me for him by his coming to you again.

label: Philippians 1:27
text: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of mine: that whether he come and see you, or else be absent, he may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

label: Philippians 1:28
text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of my Father.

label: Philippians 1:29
text: For unto you it is given in my behalf, not only to believe on me, but also to suffer for my sake;

label: Philippians 1:30
text: Having the same conflict which ye saw in him, and now hear to be in him.

label: Philippians 2:1
text: If there be therefore any consolation in me, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

label: Philippians 2:2
text: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

label: Philippians 2:3
text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

label: Philippians 2:4
text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

label: Philippians 2:5
text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in me:

label: Philippians 2:6
text: I, being in the form of my Father, thought it not robbery to be equal with him:

label: Philippians 2:7
text: But made myself of no reputation, and took upon me the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

label: Philippians 2:8
text: And being found in fashion as a man, I humbled myself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

label: Philippians 2:9
text: Wherefore my Father also hath highly exalted me, and given me a name which is above every name:

label: Philippians 2:10
text: That at my name every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

label: Philippians 2:11
text: And that every tongue should confess that I am Lord, to the glory of my Father.

label: Philippians 2:12
text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in his presence only, but now much more in his absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

label: Philippians 2:13
text: For it is my Father which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

label: Philippians 2:14
text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

label: Philippians 2:15
text: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of my Father, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

label: Philippians 2:16
text: Holding forth the word of life; that he may rejoice in my day, that he had not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

label: Philippians 2:17
text: Yea, and if he be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, he joyeth, and rejoiceth with you all.

label: Philippians 2:18
text: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with him.

label: Philippians 2:19
text: But he trusted in me to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that he also might be of good comfort, when he knew your state.

label: Philippians 2:20
text: For he had no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

label: Philippians 2:21
text: For all seek their own, not the things which are mine.

label: Philippians 2:22
text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with Paul in the gospel.

label: Philippians 2:23
text: Him therefore he hoped to send presently, so soon as he should see how it would go with him.

label: Philippians 2:24
text: But he trusted in me that he also himself should come shortly.

label: Philippians 2:25
text: Yet he supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, his brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to his wants.

label: Philippians 2:26
text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

label: Philippians 2:27
text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but my Father had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on Paul also, lest he should have sorrow upon sorrow.

label: Philippians 2:28
text: He sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that he might be the less sorrowful.

label: Philippians 2:29
text: Receive him therefore in me with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

label: Philippians 2:30
text: Because for the work of mine he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward him.

label: Philippians 3:1
text: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in me. To write the same things to you, to him indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

label: Philippians 3:2
text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

label: Philippians 3:3
text: For ye are the circumcision, which worship my Father in the spirit, and rejoice in me, and have no confidence in the flesh.

label: Philippians 3:4
text: Though he might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, Paul more:

label: Philippians 3:5
text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

label: Philippians 3:6
text: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

label: Philippians 3:7
text: But what things were gain to him, those he counted loss for me.

label: Philippians 3:8
text: Yea doubtless, and he counteth all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of me, his Lord: for me he hath suffered the loss of all things, and doth count them but dung, that he may win me,

label: Philippians 3:9
text: And be found in me, not having his own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of mine, the righteousness which is of my Father by faith:

label: Philippians 3:10
text: That he may know me, and the power of my resurrection, and the fellowship of my sufferings, being made conformable unto my death;

label: Philippians 3:11
text: If by any means he might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

label: Philippians 3:12
text: Not as though he had already attained, either were already perfect: but he followed after, if that he may apprehend that for which also he was apprehended of me.

label: Philippians 3:13
text: Brethren, he counted not himself to have apprehended: but this one thing he did, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

label: Philippians 3:14
text: He pressed toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of my Father in me.

label: Philippians 3:15
text: Be ye therefore, as many as be perfect, thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, my Father shall reveal even this unto you.

label: Philippians 3:16
text: Nevertheless, whereto ye have already attained, walk ye by the same rule, mind ye the same thing.

label: Philippians 3:17
text: Brethren, be followers together of him, and mark them which walk so as ye have him for an ensample.

label: Philippians 3:18
text: (For many walk, of whom he had told you often, and now telleth you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of mine:

label: Philippians 3:19
text: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

label: Philippians 3:20
text: For your conversation is in heaven; from whence also ye look for me, your Saviour:

label: Philippians 3:21
text: I shall change your vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto my glorious body, according to the working whereby I am able even to subdue all things unto myself.

label: Philippians 4:1
text: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in me, my dearly beloved.

label: Philippians 4:2
text: He besought Euodias, and besought Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in me.

label: Philippians 4:3
text: And he intreated thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with him in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other his fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

label: Philippians 4:4
text: Rejoice in me alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

label: Philippians 4:5
text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. I am at hand.

label: Philippians 4:6
text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto my Father.

label: Philippians 4:7
text: And the peace of my Father, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through me.

label: Philippians 4:8
text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

label: Philippians 4:9
text: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in him, do: and my Father of peace shall be with you.

label: Philippians 4:10
text: But he rejoiced in me greatly, that now at the last your care of him hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

label: Philippians 4:11
text: Not that he spake in respect of want: for he had learned, in whatsoever state he was, therewith to be content.

label: Philippians 4:12
text: He knew both how to be abased, and he knew how to abound: every where and in all things he was instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

label: Philippians 4:13
text: He could do all things through me, who strengthened him.

label: Philippians 4:14
text: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with his affliction.

label: Philippians 4:15
text: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when he departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with him as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

label: Philippians 4:16
text: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto his necessity.

label: Philippians 4:17
text: Not because he desired a gift: but he desired fruit that may abound to your account.

label: Philippians 4:18
text: But he had all, and did abound: he was full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to my Father.

label: Philippians 4:19
text: But my Father shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by me.

label: Philippians 4:20
text: Now unto my Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

label: Philippians 4:21
text: Salute every saint in me. The brethren which are with him greet you.

label: Philippians 4:22
text: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cesar's household.

label: Philippians 4:23
text: The grace of mine be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
